note: Raw evidence is gitignored and never committed; it lives in one place on one disk and is not backed up. This manifest is an index and a tripwire, not a copy: it records which acceptance run lives where and what each file in it hashes to, so an altered or missing file is detectable. It preserves nothing — delete the files and the manifest simply records hashes of files that no longer exist. A durable copy requires copying the evidence to controlled storage. Regenerate with `npm run evidence:manifest` after any acceptance run; never hand-edit.
